results.question: Joint Venture (JV)
results.answer:
• Maximum JV Members: Shall not exceed 2 (two) entities including Lead Member.
• Lead Member Financial Capacity: Must meet at least 51% of the Financial Capacity requirement.
• Other Member Financial Capacity: Must meet at least 25% of the Financial Capacity requirement.
• Cumulative Capacity: JV as a whole must cumulatively satisfy 100% of Financial & Technical Capacity requirements.
• Work Execution & Subcontracting: Lead Member must directly carry out at least 51% of the total project value; subcontracting is restricted to a maximum of 49%.
• Composition Change: Change in JV composition is strictly prohibited during the bidding stage and until full completion of the scope.

results.question: Milestone
results.answer:
• Project Milestone-I (4th month from LOA): Complete design & engineering of all disciplines and obtain approvals; submit approved Stage Payment Statements for not less than 15% of the Contract Price.
• Project Milestone-II (8th month from LOA): Submit Stage Payment Statements for an amount not less than 40% of the Contract Price.
• Project Milestone-III (12th month from LOA): Submit Stage Payment Statements for an amount not less than 65% of the Contract Price.
• Project Milestone-IV (14th month from LOA): Submit Stage Payment Statements for an amount equal to 90% of the Contract Price.
• Scheduled Completion Date (15th month from LOA): Complete construction in accordance with the Agreement.
results.source: ScheduleEtoQ_compressed.pdf, Page 20-21, Schedule J (Clauses 2.0 to 6.0)

results.question: Liquidated Damages
results.answer:
• Delay in Performance Security: Extension up to 20 days may be granted on payment of Damages at the rate of 0.05% of the Contract Price per day until Performance Security is provided.
• Authority Delay Damages: Aggregate damages payable by the Authority for delays in handing over site or utility shifting shall not exceed 0.05% of the Contract Price.
• Liquidated Damages for Delay in Completion by Contractor: Clause 8.3.1 (Damages for delay) is marked as 'Deleted' in the contract terms.
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 22 Clause 4.1.5, Page 30 Clause 7.1.3, Page 33 Clause 8.3.1

results.question: Minimum value of work to be executed interim RA payment
results.answer:
• Stage Payment Statements are linked to milestone thresholds: 15% of Contract Price (Milestone-I), 40% (Milestone-II), 65% (Milestone-III), and 90% (Milestone-IV).
• Retention Money Refund Tranches: Refund of retention money against bank guarantee shall be made in tranches of not less than 1% of the Contract Price.
results.source: ScheduleEtoQ_compressed.pdf, Page 20, Schedule J; VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 31 Clause 7.5.3

results.question: R.A Bill Payments
results.answer:
• Advance Payment: Interest-bearing advance payment equal to 10% of Contract Price for mobilization and equipment acquisition, payable in 3 installments against an unconditional BG of 110% of each installment.
• Deductions & Retention: 6% guarantee money deducted from every payment for Works as Retention Money, capped at 5% of Contract Price (or BG of equivalent amount + 10%). 50% released upon Completion Certificate and 50% upon completion of DLP.
• Billing Claims: Contractor submits Stage Payment Statements covering executed works, Change of Scope orders, price adjustments, and tax deductions.
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 31 Clause 7.5.1; ScheduleEtoQ_compressed.pdf, Page 11 Schedule G Annexure III & Page 32 Schedule M

results.question: Price Escalation
results.answer:
• Contract Price Adjustment: Clause 3.8(b) specifies that the Contract Price shall not be adjusted to take account of any unforeseen difficulties or costs.
• Site/Document Errors: Clause 6.1.3 states that mistake or error relating to RFP/site details shall not lead to any adjustment of Contract Price.
• Price Adjustment Provisions: Contract TOC lists Clause 19.10 (Adjusted contract price for the Works) and Clause 19.11 (Restrictions on price adjustment), while Clause 19.12 is marked 'Deleted'.
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 20 Clause 3.8(b), Page 28 Clause 6.1.3, Page 5-6 TOC (Clauses 19.10–19.12)

results.question: Retension Money
results.answer:
• Deduction Rate: 6% (six per cent) from every payment due to the Contractor for Works.
• Maximum Cap: Total Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
• Alternate Provision: The Contractor may, in lieu of cash retention, furnish unconditional and irrevocable Bank Guarantees of an equivalent amount plus 10% thereof.
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 31, Clause 7.5.1

results.question: Release of Retension Money
results.answer:
• Release Milestones & Split: 2.50% of Contract Price (50% of total Retention Money) remains valid up to issuance of Completion Certificate, and 2.50% of Contract Price (50% of total Retention Money) remains valid till completion of Defects Liability Period (DLP).
• Discharge Timeline: Within 15 (fifteen) days of the date of issue of Completion Certificate, the Authority shall discharge bank guarantees furnished under Clause 7.5.3 and refund balance Retention Money remaining after adjustments.
• BG Cessation: Bank Guarantee for Retention Money ceases to be in force 90 (ninety) days after the end of the Defects Liability Period.
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 31, Clause 7.5.1 & Clause 7.5.4; ScheduleEtoQ_compressed.pdf, Page 9, Schedule G Annexure-II, Clause 8

results.question: Security Deposite
results.answer:
• Performance Security: 7.5% (seven and half percent) of the Contract Price as an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee.
• Additional Performance Security (if offer is below estimated cost): 
  - 1% to 10% below cost put to tender: Demand Draft / Bank Guarantee / FDR of 1% of cost put to tender.
  - >10% up to 15% below: Cumulative amount equal to 1% plus the amount by which offer is more than 10% below.
  - >15% below: Cumulative amount plus double amount for remaining percentage below 15%.
results.source: VBNPART2RFP_compressed.pdf, Page 26, Clause 1.2.4; VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 30, Clause 7.1.1

results.question: Release of Security Deposite
results.answer:
• Additional Performance Security (Other Bidders): Returned within 7 days after the date of opening of the financial bid (for non-qualified/other bidders).
• Additional Performance Security (2nd Lowest Bidder): Returned within 3 days from the date of work order.
• Additional Performance Security (Successful L1 Bidder): Bank Guarantee shall be valid beyond 60 days from the date of expiry of the Defect Liability Period.
results.source: VBNPART2RFP_compressed.pdf, Page 26-27, Clause 1.2.4 (Notes 8, 9, 10, 12)

results.question: Performance Security
results.answer:
• Amount: 7.5% (seven and half percent) of the Contract Price in the form of an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee from a nationalized bank.
• Submission Timeline: Within 15 (fifteen) days of the date of receipt of LOA.
• Extension Condition: Extension of up to 20 (twenty) days may be granted on payment of Damages at 0.05% of the Contract Price per day.

results.question: Release of Performance Security

• Form of BG Cessation: Under Schedule G Annexure-I, Performance Security ceases to be in force 90 (ninety) days after the end of the Defects Liability Period.

results.question: Defect liability period

results.question: Water Supply
results.answer:
• Contractor Responsibility & Cost: The Contractor shall be responsible for procuring of all water and other services that it may require at its own cost (Clause 3.7) and bear all costs and charges for water required in connection with access to the Site (Clause 8.6).
• Authority Assistance: Upon written request from the Contractor, the Authority will provide reasonable assistance in obtaining access to infrastructure facilities and utilities, including water at rates and on terms no less favourable than those generally available to commercial customers receiving substantially equivalent services (Clause 4.1.6(b)).
• Statutory NOC: MSIDC is responsible for obtaining Water Supply NOC / Source Approval at the Pre-Tender Stage (Schedule F, Part B, Item 8).
• Operation Management Period: All consumables required for the 24-month Operations Management period shall be borne by the Authority (Schedule E, Page 1).
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 20, Clause 3.7; Page 23, Clause 4.1.6(b); Page 35, Clause 8.6; ScheduleEtoQ_compressed.pdf, Page 1 (Schedule E) & Page 2 (Schedule F)

results.question: Electricity Supply
results.answer:
• Contractor Responsibility & Procurement: The Contractor shall be responsible for procuring all power-electricity and other services that it may require at its own cost (Clause 3.7) and bear all costs and charges for electricity required in connection with access to the Site (Clause 8.6).
• Authority Assistance: Upon written request from the Contractor, the Authority shall provide reasonable assistance in obtaining access to infrastructure facilities and utilities, including electricity at rates and terms no less favourable than those available to commercial customers (Clause 4.1.6(b)).
• Temporary Power Works: The EPC Contractor shall design, provide, maintain, and remove temporary electrical supply and temporary lighting required for construction (Schedule B, Annexure 1, Clause 6.8).
• Permanent Infrastructure & Backup Scope: The Project requires 100% DG Backup for the building, two 11KV Grid Substation Buildings (with GIS equipment), DG set underground building, and laying/installation/termination of 33KV Transmission Lines coordinated with MSEDCL up to the substation buildings (RFP, Page 16, Clause 1.7.1 & Page 21, Clause 1.8.1(nn)).
results.source: VBNPART2VOL2EPCAGREEMENT_compressed.pdf, Page 20, Clause 3.7; Page 23, Clause 4.1.6(b); Page 35, Clause 8.6; SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 10, Clause 6.8; VBNPART2RFP_compressed.pdf, Pages 16 & 21, Clauses 1.7.1 & 1.8.1(nn)
